snippet.title: Papa's Paleteria Deluxe
snippet.description: Papa's Paleteria makes its debut on PC!  In this deluxe version, the original paleta-crafting experience has been reimagined for mouse controls and larger screens, delivering the classic hands-on gameplay to Papa's Paleteria for the first time.  Even more customers have arrived in San Fresco for paletas and ice pops, so you'll see some new faces along with your Paleteria regulars.  This version includes returning features like Daily Specials and helpful Score Detail breakdowns, as well as new holiday ingredients to serve in the Paleteria.
